build_STVQABuilder: build an STVQABuilder instance to load and configure the ST-VQA dataset for multimodal training
review_STVQABuilder_config_path: review the STVQABuilder config_path method to return the defaults YAML path for ST-VQA
test_STVQABuilder_registry: test that STVQABuilder is registered with the MMF Registry under the name stvqa
refactor_STVQABuilder_inheritance: refactor STVQABuilder to override additional methods from TextVQABuilder for custom dataset behavior
summarize_STVQABuilder_init: summarize the STVQABuilder init method that sets dataset_name and assigns STVQADataset as the dataset class
